supplier_and_assembly_conditions.detail: The analysis envelope is conditional; domestic published PAD/plug-in-hole tolerances are not a certified via-process envelope for this board. See review-r13/README.md.
Nominal mask bridges are measured; solder-mask registration capability for this order is unverified.
Nominal annuli pass CAD/DRC, but independently combining conservative maximum hole size and position bounds does not establish a guaranteed remaining annulus.
The local ±0.03 mm per-axis stencil registration acceptance bound is an assumption, not a measured printing result.
Paste avoidance does not qualify molten-solder wicking, reflow joints, or thermal performance of open PTHs.

scope: U101 open thermal PTH and relieved F.Paste geometry. Given-envelope clearance verified; factory process capability, actual print, reflow and thermal performance not certified. Full PCB routing and copper planes are pending.
